sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Sector filter test cases
sections.what: Runs two checks: one confirms off-sector words are flagged for an LNG run, and one confirms generic and same-sector wording is not flagged.
sections.why: Likely reason: the filter could wrongly drop good sentences or wrongly keep bad ones, so both directions are tested.
sections.watch_out: Each assertion fixes one exact expected result, so changing the word list may require updating these expectations.

summary: Checks that the sector filter flags benchmarks about other industries and keeps generic and same-sector ones.
purpose: Confirm that offSectorTerm returns the expected off-sector word in each sample case.
why: Likely reason: protects the rule in the methodology file that an LNG deck must not carry nuclear or Olympic examples.
how: Runs two tests with the built-in Node test runner. The first checks that nuclear, Olympic and rail words are flagged for an LNG run. The second checks that generic megaproject text, same-sector text and information technology text are not flagged.
inputs: Fixed sample sentences and fixed industry lists written into the test.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: Covers only the sample sentences listed, so a new sector word not in the filter is not caught.
debug: If a test fails, compare the sample sentence with the word list in the methodology file and check the industry list passed in. Run the file with the Node test runner.
